english: Oh, =Roasted Rice Tea=! That toasty flavor pairs with nearly any dessert.
french: Oh, du =thé au riz torréfié= ! Cette saveur grillée se marie avec presque tous les desserts.
russian: О, =чай из жареного риса=! Благодаря припечённому аромату он подходит почти к любому десерту.
bulgarian: Oh, =Roasted Rice Tea=! That toasty flavor pairs with nearly any dessert.

english: Don't mind if I do, [Ari]!
french: Je ne dis pas non, [Ari] !
russian: Приму с радостью, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Don't mind if I do, [Ari]!

english: A =Lemon Cake=?
french: Un =cake au citron= ?
russian: Это =кислый лимонный торт=?
bulgarian: A =Lemon Cake=?

english: You've made my day, thank you, [Ari]!
french: Tu viens d'illuminer ma journée, merci, [Ari] !
russian:
Ты меня очень

порадовали

порадовалапорадовалпорадовало, спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You've made my day, thank you, [Ari]!

english: This =Spell Fruit Parfait= is a masterpiece of the dessert maker's art. Truly sublime in profile and flavor.
french: Ce =parfait à l'amuse-papilles= est un chef-d'œuvre dans l'art de la confection des desserts. Sublime par son aspect autant que par son goût.
russian: Это =волшебное парфе= — вершина десертного мастерства. Великолепие облика и вкуса.
bulgarian: This =Spell Fruit Parfait= is a masterpiece of the dessert maker's art. Truly sublime in profile and flavor.

english: Thank you, [Ari]!
french: Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]!

english: =Strawberries and Cream= is a wonderful treat.
french: Les =fraises à la crème= sont une merveilleuse gourmandise.
russian: =Клубника со сливками= — чудесное лакомство.
bulgarian: =Strawberries and Cream= is a wonderful treat.

english: It's one of my favorite treats, thank you!
french: C'est l'une de mes gourmandises préférées, merci !
russian: Это же один из моих любимый десертов! Спасибо!
bulgarian: It's one of my favorite treats, thank you!

english: Oh, [Ari]! This =Strawberry Shortcake= is for me?
french: Oh, [Ari] ! Ce =fraisier= est pour moi ?
russian: Ого, [Ari]! Этот =слоёный торт с клубникой= — для меня?
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! This =Strawberry Shortcake= is for me?

english: Thank you!
french: Merci !
russian: Спасибо!
bulgarian: Thank you!

english: =Sweet Sesame Balls=! I'm certainly partial to sweet sesame.
french: Des =boules au sésame sucrées= ! J'ai un vrai penchant pour le sésame sucré.
russian: =Кунжутные шарики=! Я определённо люблю выпечку с кунжутом.
bulgarian: =Sweet Sesame Balls=! I'm certainly partial to sweet sesame.

english: I-
french: Je...
bulgarian: I-

english: Oh!
french: Oh !
russian: Ой!
bulgarian: Oh!

english: Thank you [Ari], I love it!
french: Merci, [Ari], je l'adore !
russian: Спасибо, [Ari], он очень вкусный!
bulgarian: Thank you [Ari], I love it!

english: W-what kind of cake is this?
french: D-De quel genre de gâteau s'agit-il ?
russian: Ч-что это за странный торт?
bulgarian: W-what kind of cake is this?

english: Thanks, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari].

english: =Wild Berry Pie=! Truly a classic treat of Mistria.
french: De la =tarte aux baies sauvages= ! Une gourmandise typique de Mistria.
russian: =Пирог из диких ягод=! Настоящая классика среди мистрийских десертов.
bulgarian: =Wild Berry Pie=! Truly a classic treat of Mistria.

english: Thanks!
french: Merci !
russian: Спасибо!
bulgarian: Thanks!

english: The flavor of =Wintergreen Ice Cream= is so refreshing, don't you think?
french: Le parfum de la =glace aux baies hivernales= est tellement rafraîchissant, tu ne crois pas ?
russian: Ты тоже думаешь, что у =мороженого из гаультерии= очень освежающий вкус?
bulgarian: The flavor of =Wintergreen Ice Cream= is so refreshing, don't you think?

english: I ate that whole $Void Cake$ in one sitting, but I was still hungry afterwards.
french: J'ai mangé tout ce $gâteau du néant$ en une seule fois, mais j'avais encore faim, après.
russian: Я съел весь $пустотный торт$ за один присест, но потом всё равно остался голодный.
bulgarian: I ate that whole $Void Cake$ in one sitting, but I was still hungry afterwards.

english: Strange...
french: Bizarre...
russian: Странно...
bulgarian: Strange...

english: Darcy's teas are exciting! This =Roasted Rice Tea=... it has a wonderful taste.
french: Les thés de Darcy sont formidables ! Son =thé au riz torréfié=... a un goût merveilleux.
russian: Чаи Дарси такие интересные! Например, у =чая из жареного риса= просто прекрасный вкус.
bulgarian: Darcy's teas are exciting! This =Roasted Rice Tea=... it has a wonderful taste.

english: Darcy's got cakes in today... ooh, how do I choose? Chocolate, Raspberry... I'd better get both. To support the market and all.
french: Darcy a fait des gâteaux aujourd'hui... Oh, comment choisir ? Chocolat, framboise... Je vais prendre les deux. Pour soutenir le commerce, tout ça.
russian: Сегодня у Дарси на витрине пирожные... ух, какое же выбрать? Шоколадное, клюквенное... Пожалуй, стоит взять оба. Поддержать торговлю и всё такое.
bulgarian: Darcy's got cakes in today... ooh, how do I choose? Chocolate, Raspberry... I'd better get both. To support the market and all.

english: Nothing beats tea and cake, and Darcy's got both... don't tell anyone, but this might be my favorite place at the Saturday Market.
french: Rien ne vaut un thé avec une tranche de gâteau et Darcy propose les deux... Ne le dis à personne, mais ce stand est mon préféré du marché du samedi.
russian: Нет ничего лучше чая с пирожными, и у Дарси есть и то и другое... Не говори никому, но её лавка — моя любимая на Субботнем базаре.
bulgarian: Nothing beats tea and cake, and Darcy's got both... don't tell anyone, but this might be my favorite place at the Saturday Market.

english: I heard Darcy has a new tea on the menu, so naturally I had to come try it.
french: On m'a dit que Darcy avait un nouveau thé à sa carte, il fallait que je vienne le goûter, naturellement.
russian: Услышал, что у Дарси в меню новый чай, так что, разумеется, я не мог не прийти попробовать.
bulgarian: I heard Darcy has a new tea on the menu, so naturally I had to come try it.

english: Louis has been our family tailor for years... he makes clothes for my mother and father as well.
french: Louis est notre tailleur de famille depuis des années... Il fait des vêtements pour ma mère et pour mon père.
russian: Луи уже много лет наш семейный портной... он шьёт одежду и для моих матушки и отца.
bulgarian: Louis has been our family tailor for years... he makes clothes for my mother and father as well.

english: I think Louis makes up for it when he tailors my clothes...
french: Je crois que Louis se rattrape quand ce sont mes habits qu'il coud.
russian: Луи потом отыгрывается за это на моей одежде...
bulgarian: I think Louis makes up for it when he tailors my clothes...

english: My father, Baron Wiscar, limits the gold piping to one handspan on any garment that Louis makes for him.
french: Mon père, le baron Wiscar, ne veut pas que Louis utilise plus d'une paume de passepoil doré sur les vêtements qu'il confectionne pour lui.
russian: Мой отец, барон Вискар, предпочитает ограничивать количество золотой окантовки на одежде Луи всего одним размахом рук.
bulgarian: My father, Baron Wiscar, limits the gold piping to one handspan on any garment that Louis makes for him.

english: I heard that Louis had some new sashes in stock... I love a good sash, don't you?
french: Il paraît que Louis a de nouvelles écharpes en stock... J'adore les belles écharpes, pas toi ?
russian: Слышал, у Луи на прилавке новые пояса... Я люблю качественные пояса, а ты?
bulgarian: I heard that Louis had some new sashes in stock... I love a good sash, don't you?

english: Have you ever seen the wedding outfits that Louis makes? Each is a masterpiece!
french: As-tu déjà vu les tenues de mariage que Louis confectionne ? Chacune d'elles est un chef-d'œuvre !
russian: Тебе довелось увидеть пошитые Луи свадебные наряды? Каждый из них — шедевр!
bulgarian: Have you ever seen the wedding outfits that Louis makes? Each is a masterpiece!

english: Merri's here! I once found an ancient Caldosian nightstand in her lineup...
french: Merri est là ! Un jour, j'ai trouvé sur son étal une antique table de chevet caldosienne.
russian: Мэрри в городе! Как-то раз я нашёл среди её товаров древнюю кальдосийскую прикроватную тумбу...
bulgarian: Merri's here! I once found an ancient Caldosian nightstand in her lineup...

english: Well known for their delicate interior inlays, the style was largely overshadowed by the similar but not as detailed- hey, where are you going?
french: Elles sont réputées pour la finesse de leur marqueterie intérieure, pourtant cette technique a été supplantée par un style approchant, mais moins raffiné... Hé, où tu vas ?
russian: Они широко известны своей деликатной инкрустацией, хотя такой стиль в итоге проиграл в популярности похожему, но чуть менее изощрённому... эй, ты куда?
bulgarian: Well known for their delicate interior inlays, the style was largely overshadowed by the similar but not as detailed- hey, where are you going?

english: My wardrobe and bookshelf are a matching set that I got from Merri's shop! They're both made from a wood that's not native to Mistria... maybe Celine would know something about that.
french: Mon armoire et mon étagère forment un ensemble que j'ai acheté chez Merri ! Toutes deux sont faites d'un bois qui n'est pas issu de Mistria... Céline en saurait peut-être plus ?!
russian: Два моих шкафа для одежды и для книг — это один набор, который я купил у Мэрри! Оба сделаны из дерева, которое не растёт в Мистрии... Возможно, Селин про него лучше знает.
bulgarian: My wardrobe and bookshelf are a matching set that I got from Merri's shop! They're both made from a wood that's not native to Mistria... maybe Celine would know something about that.

english: Adeline was on the hunt for a bookshelf she saw at Merri's a few months ago... I hope she finds it, she had her heart set on it!
french: Adeline était à la recherche d'une étagère qu'elle avait vue chez Merri il y a quelques mois... J'espère qu'elle la retrouvera, elle avait vraiment eu un coup de cœur !
russian: Аделина в поисках книжной полки, которую она увидела у Мэрри несколько месяцев назад... Надеюсь, её поиски увенчаются успехом. Уж очень она засматривалась на эту полку!
bulgarian: Adeline was on the hunt for a bookshelf she saw at Merri's a few months ago... I hope she finds it, she had her heart set on it!

english: Great Aunt Elsie got her entire furniture set from Merri... guess who had to carry all that upstairs? ... poor Errol...
french: Grand-tante Elsie s'est entièrement meublée chez Merri... Devine qui a dû transporter tout ça à l'étage. ... Pauvre Errol...
russian: Тётушка Элси приобрела всю свою мебель у Мэрри... Угадай, кому пришлось всё это таскать на второй этаж?.. Бедняга Эррол...
bulgarian: Great Aunt Elsie got her entire furniture set from Merri... guess who had to carry all that upstairs? ... poor Errol...

english: Stillwell said a great discovery was on the horizon! He couldn't tell me whether it was Caldosian or Aldarian, though... he just kept yelling "LOOK WITHIN"! Did he mean it was Mistrian?
bulgarian: Stillwell said a great discovery was on the horizon! He couldn't tell me whether it was Caldosian or Aldarian, though... he just kept yelling "LOOK WITHIN"! Did he mean it was Mistrian?

english: I'm never sure if Stillwell's fortunes are real, but I do feel a little spring in my step after I speak to him.
bulgarian: I'm never sure if Stillwell's fortunes are real, but I do feel a little spring in my step after I speak to him.

english: I got a love fortune from Stillwell... he said my destiny was connected to the soil. Now when's the next archaeology conference...
bulgarian: I got a love fortune from Stillwell... he said my destiny was connected to the soil. Now when's the next archaeology conference...

english: Stillwell gave me a life fortune today... "Enjoy the finer things in life while you still have time". It sounds a little ominous, but I think he meant that the Saturday Market is only one day a week.
bulgarian: Stillwell gave me a life fortune today... "Enjoy the finer things in life while you still have time". It sounds a little ominous, but I think he meant that the Saturday Market is only one day a week.

english: So please feel free to donate any underappreciated desserts to me!
french: Surtout, n'hésite pas à me faire don de tous les desserts qui n'auront pas été appréciés à leur juste valeur !
russian: Так что, пожалуйста, можешь оставить мне любой недооценённый десерт!
bulgarian: So please feel free to donate any underappreciated desserts to me!

english: Even if Taliferro doesn't enjoy your cooking, I will!
french: Même si Taliferro n'aime pas ta cuisine, moi je l'apprécierai !
russian: Если Талиферро не ценит твои блюда, то я оценю!
bulgarian: Even if Taliferro doesn't enjoy your cooking, I will!

english: It's fun when other people cook for you!
french: C'est amusant quand d'autres personnes cuisinent à ta place !
russian: А именно: приятно, когда для тебя готовят другие!
bulgarian: It's fun when other people cook for you!

english: Despite his personality, Taliferro certainly gets one thing right...
french: En dépit de son caractère, Taliferro a au moins raison sur un point...
russian: Несмотря на его характер, Талиферро всё-таки кое-что понимает...
bulgarian: Despite his personality, Taliferro certainly gets one thing right...

english: It may be hard to believe, but his hair's always been like that.
french: Crois-moi ou non, mais il a toujours eu ces cheveux-là !
russian: Возможно, тебе трудно будет поверить, но волосы у него так стояли всегда.
bulgarian: It may be hard to believe, but his hair's always been like that.

english: At least he finally grew into it!
french: Il a juste grandi assez pour avoir la taille qui va avec !
russian: Наконец-то он до них дорос!
bulgarian: At least he finally grew into it!

english: Adeline and I used to see Taliferro when we were little, whenever nobles had social events in the Capital.
french: Adeline et moi croisions Taliferro quand nous étions enfants, dès que les nobles organisaient des événements festifs à la capitale.
russian: Мы с Аделиной встречали Талиферро в детстве, когда бывали на всяких собраниях аристократии в столице.
bulgarian: Adeline and I used to see Taliferro when we were little, whenever nobles had social events in the Capital.

english: Between you and me, I think he just wants to eat all the food himself!
french: De toi à moi, je crois qu'il veut simplement tout manger tout seul !
russian: Между нами, я думаю, он просто хочет сам всё съесть!
bulgarian: Between you and me, I think he just wants to eat all the food himself!

english: That's what I want, at least.
french: En tout cas, c'est que moi, je voudrais.
russian: Во всяком случае, я так хотел.
bulgarian: That's what I want, at least.

english: I asked Taliferro if I could be one of the judges for his $Cooking Challenge$, but he refused.
french: J'ai demandé à Taliferro si je pouvais participer au jury pour son $défi gastronomique$, mais il a refusé.
russian: Я спросил Талиферро, возьмёт ли он меня в жюри $смотра блюд$, но он отказал.
bulgarian: I asked Taliferro if I could be one of the judges for his $Cooking Challenge$, but he refused.

english: Adeline says it's important to try new things now and then... I could probably try a mohawk, right?
french: Adeline dit qu'il est important d'essayer de nouvelles choses de temps à autre... Je pourrais essayer la crête, non ?
russian: Аделина говорит, что стоит иногда пробовать что-нибудь новенькое... Возможно, стоит попробовать ирокез?
bulgarian: Adeline says it's important to try new things now and then... I could probably try a mohawk, right?

english: Imagine that! A whole new historical field, just waiting to be discovered.
french: Rends-toi compte ! Un tout nouveau champ historique qui n'attend que d'être défriché.
russian: Но ты только подумай! Это же целая новая область исторических наук, нуждающаяся в исследовании.
bulgarian: Imagine that! A whole new historical field, just waiting to be discovered.

english: There aren't many records describing ancient hairstyles...
french: Les coupes de cheveux d'autrefois sont assez peu documentées...
russian: Источников, описывающих древние причёски, не так уж много...
bulgarian: There aren't many records describing ancient hairstyles...

english: It might be fun to try out red hair, like March... maybe just a streak to start with...
french: Ça pourrait être amusant de tenter le rouge, comme March... Enfin, peut-être juste une mèche, pour commencer...
russian: Попробовать покрасить волосы в красный, как у Марта, — это может быть весело... Хотя, пожалуй, стоит начать с одной пряди...
bulgarian: It might be fun to try out red hair, like March... maybe just a streak to start with...

english: Did you know that the ancient Alda considered pink hair to be... "cool"?
french: Savais-tu que les anciens habitants d'Alda considéraient qu'avoir les cheveux roses était... « cool » ?
russian: Тебе известно, что в древней Альдии розовые волосы считались... «крутыми»?
bulgarian: Did you know that the ancient Alda considered pink hair to be... "cool"?

english: But his 'artifact' turned out to be a drawing that he deemed 'witchy'!
french: En fait, son « artéfact » se résumait à un dessin qu'il trouvait « ensorcelant » !
russian: А оказалось, что его так называемый «артефакт» — просто рисунок, который показался ему «ведьмовским»!
bulgarian: But his 'artifact' turned out to be a drawing that he deemed 'witchy'!

english: It was also a very bad drawing, [Ari]. I think he drew it himself!
french: En plus, il était vraiment laid, [Ari]. Je le soupçonne de l'avoir dessiné lui-même !
russian: И даже сам рисунок был плохой, [Ari]. Думаю, он сам его нарисовал!
bulgarian: It was also a very bad drawing, [Ari]. I think he drew it himself!

english: Wheedle said he had a rare artifact from the era of the Witch Queens, and then he got me into a bidding war with Juniper...
french: Wheedle a dit qu'il détenait un artéfact rare de l'époque des Reines-sorcières. Juniper et moi, nous avons enchéri à qui mieux mieux...
russian: Хлюст сказал, что у него есть какой-то древний артефакт из Эпохи королев-ведьм. И мы с Джунипер устроили аукцион...
bulgarian: Wheedle said he had a rare artifact from the era of the Witch Queens, and then he got me into a bidding war with Juniper...

english: Mostly by adding dragons. By the time he was done with his pitch, Mistria was home to thirty-seven dragons!
french: Surtout des dragons. À la fin de sa présentation, on comptait trente-sept dragons à Mistria !
russian: В основном с помощью драконов. Когда он закончил свою презентацию, в Мистрии насчитывалось тридцать семь драконов!
bulgarian: Mostly by adding dragons. By the time he was done with his pitch, Mistria was home to thirty-seven dragons!

english: Thirty-seven! I wish!
french: Trente-sept ! Si ça pouvait être vrai !
russian: Тридцать семь! Хотелось бы!
bulgarian: Thirty-seven! I wish!

english: Wheedle keeps trying to sell me on Museum-sponsored walking tours of Mistria, to raise tourism... but then he keeps embellishing the truth.
french: Wheedle veut me vendre l'idée de balades guidées de Mistria, en lien avec le musée, pour développer le tourisme... mais il en rajoute sans cesse.
russian: Хлюст пытается убедить меня устраивать пешие прогулки по Мистрии за счёт музея для развития мистрийского туризма... Но он всё время приукрашивает картину!
bulgarian: Wheedle keeps trying to sell me on Museum-sponsored walking tours of Mistria, to raise tourism... but then he keeps embellishing the truth.

english: I'm embarrassed to say, I took him at his word, and put quite some time into piecing together his ancestry.
french: À mon grand embarras, je l'ai cru et j'ai passé un temps certain à reconstituer son arbre généalogique.
russian: Стыдно сказать, но я поверил ему на слово и потратил немало времени, изучая его родословную.
bulgarian: I'm embarrassed to say, I took him at his word, and put quite some time into piecing together his ancestry.

english: No signs of royalty, but it did turn out that his genealogical tree had a lot of Wheedles on it! It must be a family name.
french: Aucun sang royal, mais son arbre généalogique comptait beaucoup de Wheedle ! Ça doit être un nom de famille.
russian: Никакой знати там нет. Зато в его генеалогическом дереве нашлось полно Хлюстов! Вероятно, это фамилия.
bulgarian: No signs of royalty, but it did turn out that his genealogical tree had a lot of Wheedles on it! It must be a family name.

english: Wheedle once came to me claiming to be a long lost prince of Aldaria.
french: Un jour, Wheedle est venu me voir en clamant qu'il était un lointain prince d'Aldaria.
russian: Однажды Хлюст пришёл ко мне и стал утверждать, что он давным-давно пропавший альдарийский принц.
bulgarian: Wheedle once came to me claiming to be a long lost prince of Aldaria.

english: But I've looked into it since, and there's no record of a Gulliblen people.
french: J'ai fait des recherches depuis, mais je n'ai rien trouvé ces Créduls.
russian: Но потом я стал смотреть источники и нигде не нашёл записей об об этих простофилянах!
bulgarian: But I've looked into it since, and there's no record of a Gulliblen people.

english: When I told Wheedle this was the case, he told me I must be their descendant!
french: Quand j'en ai parlé à Wheedle, il m'a répondu que je devais être un de leurs descendants !
russian: Когда я сообщил об этом Хлюсту, он сказал, что я, должно быть, их потомок!
bulgarian: When I told Wheedle this was the case, he told me I must be their descendant!

english: Wheedle sold me a rare pot, allegedly from the ancient Gulliblen civilization.
french: Wheedle m'a vendu une amphore antique, remontant à la civilisation des Créduls.
russian: Хлюст продал мне редкую вазу, принадлежавшую, по его словам, древней цивилизации простофилян.
bulgarian: Wheedle sold me a rare pot, allegedly from the ancient Gulliblen civilization.

english: Imagine an archaeological lecture recorded onto one!
french: Imagine, si on pouvait enregistrer sur l'un d'eux une conférence sur l'archéologie !

bulgarian: [Ari], your smile alone deserves its own chapter in the history books of Aldaria.

english: I'm so glad you're able to make time for me, even when you're busy.
french: Ça me fait plaisir que tu prennes du temps pour moi, malgré tout ce que tu as à faire.
russian:
Приятно, что ты

нашли

нашланашёлнашло для меня время, несмотря на все дела.
bulgarian: I'm so glad you're able to make time for me, even when you're busy.

english: You make my whole day brighter!
french: Tu as illuminé ma journée !
russian: С тобой мой день стал краше!
bulgarian: You make my whole day brighter!

english: [Ari]!
french: [Ari] !
russian: [Ari]!
bulgarian: [Ari]!

english: Quite the little schemer, aren't they?
french: Cet animal nous mène par le bout du nez, pas vrai ?
russian: Вот хитрюга, правда?
bulgarian: Quite the little schemer, aren't they?

english: Don't let [pet_name] fool you, I've already fed them.
french: Ne te laisse pas amadouer par [pet_name], je lui ai déjà donné à manger.
russian: Пускай [pet_name] тебя не обманывает: еду я уже положил.
bulgarian: Don't let [pet_name] fool you, I've already fed them.

english: It's very charming.
french: C'est adorable.
russian: Выглядит ужасно обаятельно.
bulgarian: It's very charming.

english: It seems like [pet_name] always takes an interest in anything I'm up to!
french: [pet_name] s'intéresse toujours à tout ce que je fais, on dirait !
russian: [pet_name] как будто проявляет интерес ко всему, что я делаю.
bulgarian: It seems like [pet_name] always takes an interest in anything I'm up to!

english: I simply can't get the sleep I require when I'm all scrunched up!
french: Je ne dors pas assez bien quand je suis épuisé.
russian: Я не могу как следует выспаться, когда всю ночь вынужден ужиматься!
bulgarian: I simply can't get the sleep I require when I'm all scrunched up!

english: [Ari], we need a bigger bed.
french: [Ari], il nous faut un lit plus grand.
russian: [Ari], нам нужна кровать побольше.
bulgarian: [Ari], we need a bigger bed.

english: Doesn't our furniture go perfectly together?
french: Nos meubles s'accordent très bien ensemble, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Наша мебель идеально смотрится рядом, правда?
bulgarian: Doesn't our furniture go perfectly together?

english: You've done quite the excellent job decorating the house, [Ari].
french: Tu as décoré la maison avec goût, [Ari].
russian:
Ты превосходно

украсили

украсилаукрасилукрасило дом, [Ari].
bulgarian: You've done quite the excellent job decorating the house, [Ari].

english: It would make life easier if I had space to get some work done at home...
french: Ça me faciliterait la vie d'avoir un espace de travail ici.
russian: Мне было бы гораздо проще, если бы у меня дома было рабочее место...
bulgarian: It would make life easier if I had space to get some work done at home...

english: I know you're busy, but could we put my furniture somewhere in the house?
french: Je sais que tu as du travail, mais on pourrait mettre mes meubles quelque part ?
russian: Я знаю, что у тебя дела, но мы можем поставить где-нибудь в доме мою мебель?
bulgarian: I know you're busy, but could we put my furniture somewhere in the house?

english: A good omen, to be sure.
french: C'est forcément bon signe.
russian: Это определённо хороший знак.
bulgarian: A good omen, to be sure.

english: I dreamed I discovered artifacts from a lost civilization last night!
french: La nuit dernière, j'ai rêvé que je découvrais des artéfacts d'une civilisation disparue !
russian: Мне снилось, что я открыл артефакты затерянной цивилизации!
bulgarian: I dreamed I discovered artifacts from a lost civilization last night!

english: I'll put on some tea and then we can chat about the day.
french: Je vais préparer du thé et, ensuite, on pourra discuter de nos journées respectives.
russian: Сейчас я поставлю чай и можем поболтать, как прошёл день.
bulgarian: I'll put on some tea and then we can chat about the day.

english: Good evening, [Ari].
french: Bonsoir, [Ari].
russian: Доброго вечера, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good evening, [Ari].

english: Still, it makes it all worth it when I know I'll be coming home to you.
french: Mais ça en valait la peine, parce que je savais que j'allais te retrouver en rentrant à la maison.
russian: Но я рад этой суете, ведь я знаю, что дома встречусь с тобой.
bulgarian: Still, it makes it all worth it when I know I'll be coming home to you.

english: What a whirlwind of a day! I can hardly believe it's over.
french: Quelle journée mouvementée ! J'ai même du mal à croire qu'elle soit terminée.
russian: Какой суматошный был день! Наконец-то он подходит к концу.
bulgarian: What a whirlwind of a day! I can hardly believe it's over.

english: I can't wait to hear all about it.
french: J'ai hâte que tu me racontes tout ça.
russian: Расскажешь поподробнее, как он прошёл?
bulgarian: I can't wait to hear all about it.

english: You look like you've had quite the day!
french: Tu as l'air d'avoir passé une journée bien remplie !
russian: По тебе видно, что день у тебя был насыщенный!
bulgarian: You look like you've had quite the day!

english: I love you, [Ari].
french: Je t'aime, [Ari].
russian: Я люблю тебя, [Ari].
bulgarian: I love you, [Ari].

english: Ah, there's the light of my life.
french: Ah, voici la lumière de mes jours.
russian: Ах, луч света в моей жизни!
bulgarian: Ah, there's the light of my life.

english: It'll be time to break out the heavier clothes soon.
french: Ce sera bientôt le moment de sortir les vêtements chauds.
russian: Скоро придётся доставать тёплую одежду.
bulgarian: It'll be time to break out the heavier clothes soon.

english: The wind was certainly chilly today, wasn't it?
french: Le vent était un peu frais aujourd'hui, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Ветер сегодня веет прохладой.
bulgarian: The wind was certainly chilly today, wasn't it?

english: And best of all, every meal can be finished off with a slice of =Pumpkin Pie=!
french: Et surtout, chaque repas peut se finir avec une part de =tarte à la citrouille= !
russian: А самое главное, каждый приём пищи можно завершать =тыквенным пирогом=!
bulgarian: And best of all, every meal can be finished off with a slice of =Pumpkin Pie=!

english: There's so much fresh produce to enjoy in Autumn.
french: L'automne offre tellement de fruits et de légumes délicieux.
russian: Осенью так много свежих продуктов.
bulgarian: There's so much fresh produce to enjoy in Autumn.

english: I'm not missing the find of a lifetime for that!
french: Et je ne compte pas passer à côté d'une grande découverte à cause de ça !
russian: Я не готов упустить главную находку своей жизни из-за такой мелочи!
bulgarian: I'm not missing the find of a lifetime for that!

english: You wouldn't think an archaeologist would need to do much raking, but leaves in the dig site are no joke.
french: On n'imagine pas qu'un archéologue passe autant de temps à ratisser, mais les feuilles s'accumulent drôlement sur le site de fouilles.
russian: Возможно, ты не догадываешься, как часто археологам приходится работать граблями. Листья в раскопе — серьёзная помеха.
bulgarian: You wouldn't think an archaeologist would need to do much raking, but leaves in the dig site are no joke.

english: I can tell it's going to be a great day.
french: Je sais déjà que la journée s'annonce bien.
russian: Сразу видно, хороший сегодня будет день!
bulgarian: I can tell it's going to be a great day.

english: Just smell that crisp autumn air!
french: Sens-moi cet air d'automne revigorant !
russian: Чувствуешь этот бодрящий осенний воздух?
bulgarian: Just smell that crisp autumn air!

english: Just so you know, you're looking extra cute today.
french: Ton mari te trouve particulièrement en beauté aujourd'hui, tu sais.
russian:
Хочу, чтобы ты

знали

зналазналзнало: твой муж считает, что сегодня ты особенно

симпатичные

симпатичнаясимпатичныйсимпатичное.
bulgarian: Just so you know, you're looking extra cute today.

english: Good morning, [Ari].
french: Bonjour, [Ari], mon amour.
russian: Добрейшего тебе утречка, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari].

english: Made all the more perfect with you by my side, [Ari].
french: D'autant plus que tu es à mes côtés, [Ari].
russian: Твоё присутствие делает его ещё прекраснее, [Ari].
bulgarian: Made all the more perfect with you by my side, [Ari].

english: Ah, another wonderful day in Mistria.
french: Ah, une merveilleuse journée s'annonce encore à Mistria.
russian: Ах, ещё один чудесный мистрийский денёк.
bulgarian: Ah, another wonderful day in Mistria.

english: Ideally with you by my side.
french: De préférence, avec toi à mes côtés.
russian: Желательно с тобой под боком.
bulgarian: Ideally with you by my side.

english: This rain makes me want to curl up in front of the fire for the rest of the evening...
french: Est-ce que cette pluie ne donne pas envie de passer la soirée au chaud, devant le feu ?
russian: От такого дождя хочется свернуться у огня и пролежать так весь вечер.
bulgarian: This rain makes me want to curl up in front of the fire for the rest of the evening...

english: Let's keep our eyes peeled!
french: Ouvrons l'œil !
russian: Давай будем смотреть как следует!
bulgarian: Let's keep our eyes peeled!

english: Nothing like a rainy day to help reveal new dig spots.
french: Rien ne vaut une journée de pluie pour découvrir de nouveaux endroits de fouille.
russian: В дождливые дни особенно хорошо искать новые места для раскопов.
bulgarian: Nothing like a rainy day to help reveal new dig spots.

english: Perhaps we can sneak in a nap together later.
french: On pourrait peut-être se faire une petite sieste tout à l'heure.
russian: Может, улучим момент и поспим днём вместе?
bulgarian: Perhaps we can sneak in a nap together later.

english: Are you as sleepy as I am today?
french: Je suis mort de fatigue aujourd'hui, pas toi ?
russian: Тебя тоже сегодня клонит в сон?
bulgarian: Are you as sleepy as I am today?

english: Perhaps we should call it an early night so we can get properly... warmed up.
french: On pourrait peut-être aller se coucher plus tôt pour se réchauffer.
russian: Возможно, нам лучше закончить пораньше и пойти хорошенько... отогреться.
bulgarian: Perhaps we should call it an early night so we can get properly... warmed up.

english: That snow today has me chilled through.
french: La neige m'a saisi aujourd'hui.
russian: Сегодняшний снегопад меня пробрал до костей.
bulgarian: That snow today has me chilled through.

english: I have half a mind to get back under the covers with you.
french: J'ai presque envie de retourner sous les couvertures avec toi.
russian: Склоняюсь к тому, чтобы полезть обратно под одеяло вместе с тобой.
bulgarian: I have half a mind to get back under the covers with you.

english: Looks like we're in for a good bit of snow today.
french: J'ai l'impression qu'il va neiger toute la journée.
russian: Кажется, сегодня нас ждёт большой снегопад.
bulgarian: Looks like we're in for a good bit of snow today.

english: Hopefully I can put a good dent into it!
french: J'espère que je vais bien avancer !
russian: Надеюсь, сегодня получится продуктивно!
bulgarian: Hopefully I can put a good dent into it!

english: Lots to do today! I think I'm looking forward to the artifact cataloguing the most, it's always so satisfying.
french: J'ai beaucoup de travail aujourd'hui ! Mais j'adore cataloguer les artéfacts, alors ça ne me dérange pas le moins du monde.
russian: Сегодня столько дел! Больше всего, наверное, хочу заняться каталогизацией артефактов. Такое приятная работа.
bulgarian: Lots to do today! I think I'm looking forward to the artifact cataloguing the most, it's always so satisfying.

english: Everything just grows so fast!
french: Tout pousse à une vitesse folle !
russian: Всё растёт с удивительной скоростью!
bulgarian: Everything just grows so fast!

english: You wouldn't believe the amount of weeding the Western Ruins needs in the spring.
french: Tu n'imagines pas toutes les mauvaises herbes que je dois arracher dans les ruines de l'ouest à l'arrivée du printemps.
russian: Ты даже не представляешь, как часто нужно пропалывать Западные руины по весне.
bulgarian: You wouldn't believe the amount of weeding the Western Ruins needs in the spring.

english: Everyone is always extra cheerful!
french: Tout le monde est toujours de bonne humeur !
russian: Все вокруг такие приветливые!
bulgarian: Everyone is always extra cheerful!

english: Isn't springtime in Mistria wonderful?
french: Le printemps n'est-il pas une saison merveilleuse à Mistria ?
russian: Весна в Мистрии просто чудесная, правда?
bulgarian: Isn't springtime in Mistria wonderful?

english: Funny how archaeology books skim over all the careful dusting that's required in this profession.
french: C'est assez drôle, les livres traitant de l'archéologie parlent assez rarement de toute la poussière qu'il faut enlever.
russian: Любопытно: ни один учебник по археологии не упоминает, как много в этой профессии зависит от навыка аккуратно смахивать пыль.
bulgarian: Funny how archaeology books skim over all the careful dusting that's required in this profession.

english: Errol decided that the Museum needs a good spring cleaning.
french: Errol a décidé qu'il allait faire un grand nettoyage de printemps dans le musée.
russian: Эррол решил, что в музее надо провести весеннюю уборку.
bulgarian: Errol decided that the Museum needs a good spring cleaning.

english: I can't wait!
french: J'ai hâte !
russian: Уже хочу туда!
bulgarian: I can't wait!

english: Spring weather is the finest weather to get work done at the dig site.
french: Le printemps est la saison idéale pour travailler sur le site de fouilles.
russian: Весенняя погода — лучшая для работ на раскопках.
bulgarian: Spring weather is the finest weather to get work done at the dig site.

english: Autumn can't come soon enough!
french: Vivement cet automne !
russian: Как же я жду, когда придёт осень!
bulgarian: Autumn can't come soon enough!

english: The Museum was a hot house today.
french: Le musée était une vraie étuve aujourd'hui.
russian: В музее сегодня была настоящая парилка.
bulgarian: The Museum was a hot house today.

english: We should plan to go together sometime soon, do a little beach combing.
french: On devrait y aller. J'ai bien envie de fouiller un peu le sable.
russian: Давай запланируем совместный поход. Прочешем пляжную полосу.
bulgarian: We should plan to go together sometime soon, do a little beach combing.

english: I'm so glad Mistria has a beach, aren't you?
french: Heureusement qu'il y a la plage à Mistria, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Хорошо, что в Мистрии есть пляж, правда?
bulgarian: I'm so glad Mistria has a beach, aren't you?

english: I'm afraid he talked me into too much brocade again, I'm sweltering.
french: Encore une fois, il m'a convaincu d'ajouter trop de brocart. Je suis en nage.
russian: В прошлый раз я поддался на его уговоры и переборщил с парчой, а теперь парюсь.
bulgarian: I'm afraid he talked me into too much brocade again, I'm sweltering.

english: I think I need to talk to Louis about a summer outfit in a lighter fabric.
french: Il faudrait que je demande à Louis de me confectionner une tenue un peu plus légère.
russian: По-моему, мне надо поговорить с Луи насчёт летнего костюма из более тонкой ткани.
bulgarian: I think I need to talk to Louis about a summer outfit in a lighter fabric.

english: I could certainly go for an ice cream, how about you?
french: D'ailleurs, j'en mangerais bien une, pas toi ?
russian: Я точно не откажусь от мороженого, а ты?
bulgarian: I could certainly go for an ice cream, how about you?

english: The best part of summer is when you need a treat to "cool down" no one bats an eye!
french: L'avantage en été, c'est qu'on peut se rafraîchir en mangeant une petite glace et personne ne nous juge !
russian: Самое лучшее, что есть в лете: никто не осудит, если я захочу «охладиться» сладким!
bulgarian: The best part of summer is when you need a treat to "cool down" no one bats an eye!

english: It's needful, but there's so much of it!
french: C'est nécessaire, mais ça prend une éternité !
russian: Это необходимая работа, но как же её много!
bulgarian: It's needful, but there's so much of it!

english: It seems like winter is the season to catch up on the Museum's paperwork...
french: Je crois que l'hiver est la saison idéale pour rattraper toute la paperasse en retard au musée...
russian: Кажется, зима — это специальный сезон для того, чтобы разобрать отложенные документы по музею...
bulgarian: It seems like winter is the season to catch up on the Museum's paperwork...

english: There's some very fashion forward choices this season, maybe I'll pick up one or two.
french: Certaines étaient très originales. Je vais peut-être m'en acheter une ou deux.
russian: Там встречаются весьма передовые сезонные образы. Может, я прикуплю парочку.
bulgarian: There's some very fashion forward choices this season, maybe I'll pick up one or two.

english: The new winter cloak catalogue came in from the Tailor's Guild.
french: La Guilde des tailleurs nous a envoyé son nouveau catalogue de capes d'hiver.
russian: Гильдия портных прислала новый каталог зимних пальто.
bulgarian: The new winter cloak catalogue came in from the Tailor's Guild.

english: Well, I suppose it can wait till spring.
french: Tant pis, je n'ai plus qu'à attendre l'arrivée du printemps.
russian: Что ж, придётся отложить до весны.
bulgarian: Well, I suppose it can wait till spring.

english: I feel like a bit of on-site archaeology work, but this snow...
french: J'aimerais bien mener quelques fouilles sur le terrain, mais avec cette neige...
russian: Меня сегодня тянет на полевую работу, но с таким слоем снега...
bulgarian: I feel like a bit of on-site archaeology work, but this snow...

english: Still, that's not all bad. It means we'll need extra treats to stave it off!
french: Mais c'est plutôt une bonne chose. On devra manger quelques douceurs supplémentaires pour se réchauffer !
russian: Впрочем, в этом есть свои плюсы. Нам нужно есть больше сладкого, чтобы отогреться!
bulgarian: Still, that's not all bad. It means we'll need extra treats to stave it off!

english: Cold today, isn't it?
french: Il fait frisquet aujourd'hui, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Холодно сегодня, да?
bulgarian: Cold today, isn't it?

english: There were some intriguing finds at the dig site today that I wanted to finish cataloguing.
french: Nous avons fait plusieurs découvertes intéressantes aujourd'hui et je voulais finir de les cataloguer.
russian: Сегодня в раскопе были весьма интригующие находки. Хочу их задокументировать, пока память свежа.
bulgarian: There were some intriguing finds at the dig site today that I wanted to finish cataloguing.

english: Let me know if I'm working too much, I can wrap it up.
french: Dis-moi si tu trouves que je travaille trop. Je peux remballer.
russian: Скажи, если я слишком увлекусь работой. Я могу закончить.
bulgarian: Let me know if I'm working too much, I can wrap it up.

english: It'd be fun to do some traveling with you one day and see more of the wonders of the world, wouldn't it?
french: Ce serait amusant qu'un jour, on parte en voyage tous les deux et qu'on découvre les merveilles de ce monde.
russian: Хорошо было бы нам с тобой когда-нибудь отправиться в путешествие. Посмотреть на всяческие чудеса света.
bulgarian: It'd be fun to do some traveling with you one day and see more of the wonders of the world, wouldn't it?

english: I'm responding to a fellow archaeologist's correspondence. She's working at a fascinating site up north.
french: Je suis en train d'écrire à une consœur archéologue. Elle travaille sur un site fascinant un peu plus au nord.
russian: Я пишу ответ на письмо коллеги-археолога. Она работает на потрясающем памятнике к северу отсюда.
bulgarian: I'm responding to a fellow archaeologist's correspondence. She's working at a fascinating site up north.

english: It's so rewarding to piece together history.
french: C'est tellement valorisant de reconstituer l'histoire.
russian: Собирать историю по кусочкам — сплошное удовольствие.
bulgarian: It's so rewarding to piece together history.

english: We're so lucky how many artifacts have held up over the years.
french: Nous avons tellement de chance d'avoir découvert tous ces artéfacts au fil des années.
russian: Нам очень повезло, что так много артефактов дошли до нас в уцелевшем виде.
bulgarian: We're so lucky how many artifacts have held up over the years.

english: It's a fascinating read!
french: C'est fascinant !
russian: Потрясающее чтиво!
bulgarian: It's a fascinating read!

english: The Caldosian Archaeology Society just released their latest findings paper.
french: Le dernier numéro des cahiers de la Société d'archéologie caldosienne vient de sortir.
russian: Кальдосийское археологическое общество опубликовало статьи с описанием их последних находок.
bulgarian: The Caldosian Archaeology Society just released their latest findings paper.

english: Nothing that a bit of relaxing can't cure.
french: Il suffit que je souffle un peu et ça ira.
russian: Ну ничего, хороший отдых мне поможет.
bulgarian: Nothing that a bit of relaxing can't cure.

english: Phew, I may have overdone it!
french: Pfiou, je crois que j'ai un peu trop forcé !
russian: Фух, кажется, я заработался!
bulgarian: Phew, I may have overdone it!

english: His fieldwork is rather... questionable...
french: Ses méthodes de travail sont parfois limites...
russian: Его подход к полевой работе... вызывает вопросы...
bulgarian: His fieldwork is rather... questionable...
