russian: И ещё мне пришлось две недели делать за ней домашние дела.
bulgarian: And I had to do her chores for two weeks.

english: It seems that Maple, Luc, and Dell are always getting up to mischief of some kind.
french: Maple, Luc et Dell ne sont jamais à court d'idées pour trouver des bêtises à faire.
russian: Мэйпл, Люк и Делл постоянно занимаются какими-то проказами.
bulgarian: It seems that Maple, Luc, and Dell are always getting up to mischief of some kind.

english: Think of what we might know today, if our ancestors had used more archival materials.
french: Imagine toutes les connaissances auxquelles nous aurions accès si nos ancêtres avaient utilisé des matériaux plus résistants.
russian: Только подумай, как много мы могли бы узнать, если бы наши предки использовали более долговечные материалы.
bulgarian: Think of what we might know today, if our ancestors had used more archival materials.

english: I wish they had simply written all of their documents onto fired clay tablets.
french: Il aurait fallu qu'ils consignent tout leur savoir sur des tablettes d'argile.
russian: Было бы гораздо лучше, если бы они писали документы на табличках из обожжённой глины.
bulgarian: I wish they had simply written all of their documents onto fired clay tablets.

english: Awfully inconsiderate of them!
french: Ah, ils auraient pu faire un effort !
russian: Ужасно непредусмотрительно с их стороны!
bulgarian: Awfully inconsiderate of them!

english: But Eiland... you write all your manuscripts on paper.
french: Eiland... toi aussi, tu écris sur du papier.
russian: Но, Эйланд... Ты же пишешь свои рукописи на бумаге.
bulgarian: But Eiland... you write all your manuscripts on paper.

english: Yes, awfully so! It's like they never considered a future archaeologist's needs when recording all their missives!
french: Oui, tout à fait ! C'est comme s'ils n'avaient pas réfléchi aux archéologues du futur lorsqu'ils rédigeaient leur courrier !
russian: Да, просто ужасно! Как будто они даже не задумывались о будущих археологах, когда писали свои грамоты!
bulgarian: Yes, awfully so! It's like they never considered a future archaeologist's needs when recording all their missives!

english: Actually, now that I think about it...
french: Eh bien, maintenant que j'y pense...
russian: Кстати, это навело меня на мысль...
bulgarian: Actually, now that I think about it...

english: Perhaps I should take to transcribing all my field notes into clay...?
french: Je ferais peut-être mieux de coucher toutes mes notes dans l'argile, moi aussi...
russian: Может быть, пора заняться перенесением моих полевых заметок на глину?
bulgarian: Perhaps I should take to transcribing all my field notes into clay...?

english: Ah! Point taken.
french: Oui, tu as raison !
russian: А! Дело говоришь.
bulgarian: Ah! Point taken.

english: Perhaps I should take to transcribing all my field notes into clay...?
french: Je ferais peut-être mieux de coucher toutes mes notes dans l'argile, moi aussi...
russian: Может быть, пора заняться перенесением моих полевых заметок на глину?
bulgarian: Perhaps I should take to transcribing all my field notes into clay...?

english: Sigh. It pains me to think that so many manuscripts have been lost to moisture and decay over the centuries...
french: Quel dommage que l'humidité et les siècles nous aient privés de tant de manuscrits...
russian: Эх. Мне так грустно оттого, что многие рукописи утрачены в веках из-за влажности и ветхости...
bulgarian: Sigh. It pains me to think that so many manuscripts have been lost to moisture and decay over the centuries...

english: Do you mind if I ask... a rather direct question?
french: Puis-je te poser une question... assez directe ?
russian: Можно задать тебе... один прямой вопрос?
bulgarian: Do you mind if I ask... a rather direct question?

english: I'll plan to double up my orders with Darcy instead!
french: Bon, j'achèterai deux fois plus chez Darcy à la place !
russian: Тогда я удвою свои заказы у Дарси!
bulgarian: I'll plan to double up my orders with Darcy instead!

english: Do you think I could convince Nora to bring a second dessert vendor to the Saturday Market?
french: Penses-tu que je pourrais convaincre Nora d'autoriser la venue d'un deuxième pâtissier au marché du samedi ?
russian: Как ты думаешь, я смогу убедить Нору пригласить на Субботний базар второго продавца десертов.
bulgarian: Do you think I could convince Nora to bring a second dessert vendor to the Saturday Market?

english: I'm not sure that would be good for Darcy's business.
french: Je ne pense pas que ce serait très bon pour les affaires de Darcy.
russian: Подозреваю, что это плохо отразится на выручке Дарси.
bulgarian: I'm not sure that would be good for Darcy's business.

english: I'm not sure that Nora shares your priorities...
french: Je ne crois pas que Nora ait le même sens des priorités que toi...
russian: Подозреваю, что Нора не разделяет твои приоритеты...
bulgarian: I'm not sure that Nora shares your priorities...

english: Oh! I didn't even consider that!
french: Oh ! Je n'y avais même pas pensé !
russian: Ой! Я об этом даже не подумал!
bulgarian: Oh! I didn't even consider that!

english: I suppose not everyone would patronize both stalls each week.
french: J'imagine que tout le monde ne ferait pas ses emplettes sur les deux stands chaque semaine.
russian: Действтительно, ведь некоторые не будут каждую неделю заходить в оба заведения.
bulgarian: I suppose not everyone would patronize both stalls each week.

english: Thank you for your honesty, [Ari].
french: Merci de ta franchise, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо за честный ответ, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you for your honesty, [Ari].

english: I'll plan to double up my orders with Darcy instead!
french: Bon, j'achèterai deux fois plus chez Darcy à la place !
russian: Тогда я удвою свои заказы у Дарси!
bulgarian: I'll plan to double up my orders with Darcy instead!

english: Ah, yes... she must have many things to consider on the business side of things.
french: Ah, oui... Elle doit avoir beaucoup de choses à prendre en compte pour que le marché fonctionne.
russian: Ах, да... Ей приходится взвешивать множество факторов со стороны бизнеса.
bulgarian: Ah, yes... she must have many things to consider on the business side of things.

english: I suppose there is a risk that not everyone would patronize both dessert stalls each week.
french: Et puis, il y aurait sûrement le risque que tout le monde ne fasse pas ses emplettes sur les deux stands chaque semaine.
russian: Вероятно, есть риск, что не все будут посещать обе десертных лавки каждую неделю.
bulgarian: I suppose there is a risk that not everyone would patronize both dessert stalls each week.

english: Thank you for your honesty, [Ari].
french: Merci de ta franchise, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо за честный ответ, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you for your honesty, [Ari].

english: [Ari]!
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: [Ari]!
bulgarian: [Ari]!

english: Of course, this was during his time on the front, before he was raised to peerage.
french: Eh oui, il était au front à l'époque, avant qu'il ne soit anobli.
russian: Разумеется, он в это время был на фронте. Ему тогда ещё не пожаловали титул.
bulgarian: Of course, this was during his time on the front, before he was raised to peerage.

english: It's romantic, in its own way...
french: Je trouve ça romantique, d'une certaine manière.
russian: Это по-своему романтично...
bulgarian: It's romantic, in its own way...

english: But I'm grateful that I can stay close to the one I care about, and see <she>her</she><he>him</he><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>you</none> every day.
french: Mais j'ai la chance de rester aux côtés de la personne que j'aime, jour après jour.
russian:
Но я рад, что мой самый дорогой человек рядом со мной, и я могу видеть

их

еёегоего каждый день.
bulgarian: But I'm grateful that I can stay close to the one I care about, and see <she>her</she><he>him</he><they>them</they><it>it</it><none>you</none> every day.

english: It's strange to think that when my father first started courting my mother, they could only communicate through letters.
french: C'est drôle de se dire que quand mon père a commencé à courtiser ma mère, ils ne communiquaient que par courrier interposé.
russian: Странно даже подумать, что мой отец, когда только начал ухаживать за матерью, мог общаться с ней только в письмах.
bulgarian: It's strange to think that when my father first started courting my mother, they could only communicate through letters.

english: I recently started a new line of research into the history of Aldarian courtship practices!
french: Récemment, j'ai commencé des recherches sur les techniques de séduction tout au long de l'histoire aldarienne.
russian: Недавно я начал новое направление исследований, посвящённое альдарийским традициям ухаживания.
bulgarian: I recently started a new line of research into the history of Aldarian courtship practices!

english: While our ancestors, the Alda, tended to give more flowers and gems to their partners.
french: Alors que nos ancêtres, le peuple d'Alda, offraient plutôt des fleurs et des bijoux.
russian: Но наши предки, альдийцы, чаще дарили партнёрам цветы или драгоценные камни.
bulgarian: While our ancestors, the Alda, tended to give more flowers and gems to their partners.

english: I, ah... I thought it might be fun to follow the more traditional practice, this time.
french: Donc, euh... je me suis dit que ce serait amusant de suivre la méthode ancestrale pour une fois.
russian: Я, эм... Я подумал, что в этот раз можно для интереса попробовать последовать традициям.
bulgarian: I, ah... I thought it might be fun to follow the more traditional practice, this time.

english: Here, [Ari]. These are for you.
french: Tiens, [Ari]. C'est pour toi.
russian: Держи, [Ari]. Это для тебя.
bulgarian: Here, [Ari]. These are for you.

english: Some customs, such as the $Shooting Star Festival$, have remained largely unchanged over the years...
french: Certaines coutumes, comme la $fête des étoiles filantes$, n'ont quasiment pas évolué au fil des siècles...
russian: Некоторые обряды сохранились почти без изменений: например, $Фестиваль падающих звёзд$...
bulgarian: Some customs, such as the $Shooting Star Festival$, have remained largely unchanged over the years...

english: But it's the things that have changed that I find most fascinating!
french: Mais c'est ce qui a changé qui me fascine le plus !
russian: Но более поразительны как раз те вещи, которые изменились!
bulgarian: But it's the things that have changed that I find most fascinating!

english: Ooh, tell me more!
french: Oh, dis-m'en plus !
russian: Ого, расскажи поподробнее!
bulgarian: Ooh, tell me more!

english: And why are you studying courtship practices?
french: Pourquoi t'intéresses-tu à ce sujet ?
russian: И почему же ты решил исследовать обряды ухаживания?
bulgarian: And why are you studying courtship practices?

english: Well, us present-day Aldarians tend to give food as gifts, more so than other things.
french: De nos jours, les Aldariens offrent le plus souvent de la nourriture en cadeau.
russian: Ну, мы, в современной Альдарии, обычно дарим в качестве подарков еду. По крайней мере, чаще, чем другие вещи.
bulgarian: Well, us present-day Aldarians tend to give food as gifts, more so than other things.

english: While our ancestors, the Alda, tended to give more flowers and gems to their partners.
french: Alors que nos ancêtres, le peuple d'Alda, offraient plutôt des fleurs et des bijoux.
russian: Но наши предки, альдийцы, чаще дарили партнёрам цветы или драгоценные камни.
bulgarian: While our ancestors, the Alda, tended to give more flowers and gems to their partners.

english: I, ah... I thought it might be fun to follow the more traditional practice, this time.
french: Donc, euh... je me suis dit que ce serait amusant de suivre la méthode ancestrale pour une fois.
russian: Я, эм... Я подумал, что в этот раз можно для интереса попробовать последовать традициям.
bulgarian: I, ah... I thought it might be fun to follow the more traditional practice, this time.

english: Here, [Ari]. These are for you.
french: Tiens, [Ari]. C'est pour toi.
russian: Держи, [Ari]. Это для тебя.
bulgarian: Here, [Ari]. These are for you.

english: Ah... well, it's a topic that's been on my mind lately.
french: Ah... Eh bien, c'est un sujet qui me tient à cœur ces temps-ci.
russian: А... Эта тема в последнее время меня заинтересовала.
bulgarian: Ah... well, it's a topic that's been on my mind lately.

english: It's interesting. Present-day Aldarians tend to give food as gifts, more so than other things.
french: C'est intéressant. De nos jours, les Aldariens offrent le plus souvent de la nourriture en cadeau.
russian: Любопытно, что в современной Альдарии мы обычно дарим в качестве подарков еду. По крайней мере, чаще, чем другие вещи.
bulgarian: It's interesting. Present-day Aldarians tend to give food as gifts, more so than other things.

english: I've been meaning to tell you, [Ari]!
french: Je voulais te dire quelque chose, [Ari] !
russian: Я давно хочу тебе сообщить, [Ari].
bulgarian: I've been meaning to tell you, [Ari]!

english: That means I'm no stranger to working the earth!
french: Autrement dit, je n'hésite plus à mettre les mains dans la terre.
russian: А это значит, что я не чужд работам в земле!
bulgarian: That means I'm no stranger to working the earth!

english: So, if there ever comes a time when you need help on the farm... know that you can rely on me to roll up my sleeves!
french: Alors, si jamais tu as besoin d'aide à la ferme un jour, sache que tu peux compter sur moi !
russian: Так что, если когда-нибудь тебе вдруг понадобится помощь на ферме... знай, что я помогу, засучив рукава!
bulgarian: So, if there ever comes a time when you need help on the farm... know that you can rely on me to roll up my sleeves!

english: I think you'd make a fine farmer!
french: D'après moi, tu ferais un super fermier !
russian: Думаю, из тебя выйдет отличный фермер!
bulgarian: I think you'd make a fine farmer!

english: Have you ever grown anything before?
french: Tu as déjà fait pousser quelque chose ?
russian: А ты что-нибудь выращивал раньше?
bulgarian: Have you ever grown anything before?

english: Thank you! I can't say I have a tremendous amount of experience, but-
french: Merci ! Je ne dirais pas que j'ai beaucoup d'expérience, mais...
russian: Спасибо! Не могу похвастаться огромным опытом, но...
bulgarian: Thank you! I can't say I have a tremendous amount of experience, but-

english: I have a great deal of exuberance for learning new skills!
french: J'ai toujours une grande envie d'apprendre.
russian: Зато я полон рвения осваивать новые навыки!
bulgarian: I have a great deal of exuberance for learning new skills!

english: When something or... someone piques my interest.
french: Surtout si quelque chose ou... quelqu'un suscite mon intérêt.
russian: Если что-то... или кто-то меня заинтересует.
bulgarian: When something or... someone piques my interest.

english: I can't say that I have a tremendous amount of experience, but-
french: Je ne dirais pas que j'ai beaucoup d'expérience, mais...
russian: Не могу похвастаться огромным опытом, но...
bulgarian: I can't say that I have a tremendous amount of experience, but-

english: I have a great deal of exuberance for learning new skills!
french: J'ai toujours une grande envie d'apprendre.
russian: Зато я полон рвения осваивать новые навыки!
bulgarian: I have a great deal of exuberance for learning new skills!

english: When something or... someone piques my interest.
french: Surtout si quelque chose ou... quelqu'un suscite mon intérêt.
russian: Если что-то... или кто-то меня заинтересует.
bulgarian: When something or... someone piques my interest.

english: These days I consider myself an archaeologist first and a noble second.
french: Désormais, je me vois plus comme un archéologue qu'un aristocrate.
russian: Сейчас я стал считать себя археологом в первую очередь, а дворянином лишь во вторую.
bulgarian: These days I consider myself an archaeologist first and a noble second.

english: But lately she's very keen on offering her insight into what makes a couple compatible.
french: Mais récemment, elle insiste beaucoup sur ce qui fait, selon elle, qu'un couple s'entend bien.
russian: Но в последнее время она стала настойчиво предлагать советы о совместимости пар.
bulgarian: But lately she's very keen on offering her insight into what makes a couple compatible.

english: Though, honestly... I'd let you have the last cookie, if it came down to it.
french: Même si, franchement, je te laisserais le dernier biscuit s'il le fallait.
russian: Хотя, честно говоря...Я бы отдал тебе последнюю печеньку, если бы за этим стало дело.
bulgarian: Though, honestly... I'd let you have the last cookie, if it came down to it.

english: Apparently it's not just having things in common that makes for a good match.
french: Apparemment, il ne suffit pas d'avoir des points communs pour s'entendre.
russian: Оказывается, мало иметь что-то общее, чтобы быть хорошей парой.
bulgarian: Apparently it's not just having things in common that makes for a good match.

english: The ways in which you're opposite also makes a difference!
french: Les désaccords sont aussi très importants !
russian: Также играют роль области, в которых люди противоположны!
bulgarian: The ways in which you're opposite also makes a difference!

english: She thinks we're well suited for each other, and I'm inclined to agree.
french: Elle trouve que nous allons bien ensemble, et j'aurais tendance à lui donner raison.
russian: Она считает, что мы с тобой хорошо друг другу подходим, и я склонен согласиться.
bulgarian: She thinks we're well suited for each other, and I'm inclined to agree.

english: Because I'm an adventurer and you're a scholar?
french: Parce que je suis <she>une aventurière</she><he>un aventurier</he><they>un·e aventurier·ère</they> et toi, un savant ?
russian: Потому что я занимаюсь приключениями, а ты исследованиями?
bulgarian: Because I'm an adventurer and you're a scholar?

english: Because you're way more into sweets than I am?
french: Parce que tu es beaucoup plus bec sucré que moi ?
russian: Потому что тебе гораздо больше меня нравятся сладости?
bulgarian: Because you're way more into sweets than I am?

english: Well... yes! That is one reason.
french: Eh bien, oui ! Entre autres.
russian: Ну... да! Это одна из причин.
bulgarian: Well... yes! That is one reason.

english: Your strength and bravery allow you to explore the depths of the mines...
french: Ta force et ton courage te permettent d'explorer les mines jusqu'à leurs tréfonds...
russian: Твоя сила и смелость помогают тебе исследовать недра шахт...
bulgarian: Your strength and bravery allow you to explore the depths of the mines...

english: Allowing me to focus on studying and cataloguing the artifacts you bring back!
french: Cela me permet de me concentrer sur l'étude et le catalogage des artéfacts que tu rapportes.
russian: А это позволяет мне сосредоточиться на изучении и описании артефактов, которые ты оттуда приносишь!
bulgarian: Allowing me to focus on studying and cataloguing the artifacts you bring back!

english: Well... yes! That is one reason.
french: Eh bien, oui ! Entre autres.
russian: Ну... да! Это одна из причин.
bulgarian: Well... yes! That is one reason.

english: Imagine the potential for dessert drama if we were both like this.
french: Imagine les crises que cela provoquerait si on se battait pour des desserts.
russian: Представляешь, какие были бы споры за десерты, если бы мы оба их любили.
bulgarian: Imagine the potential for dessert drama if we were both like this.

english: Great Aunt Elsie always jumps on the chance to talk about romance when the opportunity arises...
french: Grand-tante Elsie ne rate jamais une occasion de parler d'amour et d'idylle...
russian: Тётушка Элси всегда использует любую подвернувшуюся возможность поговорить о романтике...
bulgarian: Great Aunt Elsie always jumps on the chance to talk about romance when the opportunity arises...

english: It's comforting to think that I was always meant to be exactly as I am, living in these exact circumstances...
french: C'est rassurant de se dire qu'on était prédestiné à être qui on est, à vivre tel que nous vivons.
russian: Удобно считать, что мне предначертано быть ровно там, где я есть, и жить именно в этих условиях...
bulgarian: It's comforting to think that I was always meant to be exactly as I am, living in these exact circumstances...

english: But I believe in fate, too.
french: Mais je crois aussi à son influence sur nous.
russian: Но и в судьбу я тоже верю.
bulgarian: But I believe in fate, too.

english: Our lives, relationships, and fates...
french: Nos vies, nos relations et nos parcours...
russian: Наши жизни, отношения, судьбы...
bulgarian: Our lives, relationships, and fates...

english: They all form us as we're forming them.
french: Ils font de nous ce que nous sommes, mais c'est aussi nous qui les choisissons.
russian: Всё это нас формирует, но и мы формируем их.
bulgarian: They all form us as we're forming them.

english: Just think of all the paths that we took... that lead us both here.
french: Pense aux chemins que nous avons empruntés... et qui nous ont menés tous les deux ici.
russian: Только подумай, сколько развилок было на наших путях... прежде, чем мы оказались здесь вместе.
bulgarian: Just think of all the paths that we took... that lead us both here.

english: Surely, it's more than serendipity.
french: C'est bien plus qu'un simple hasard.
russian: Это не может быть просто счастливым совпадением.
bulgarian: Surely, it's more than serendipity.

english: But I understand why one may find the idea of fate a bit... stifling. What are your thoughts, [Ari]?
french: Mais je comprends qu'on puisse trouver cette idée de destin quelque peu... écrasante. Qu'en penses-tu, [Ari] ?
russian: Но также я понимаю, почему идея судьбы может казаться... угнетающей. А ты как думаешь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: But I understand why one may find the idea of fate a bit... stifling. What are your thoughts, [Ari]?

english: I believe in fate.
french: Je crois au destin.
russian: Я верю в судьбу.
bulgarian: I believe in fate.

english: I'm creating my own destiny!
french: C'est moi qui décide de mon destin !
russian: Я создаю судьбу своими руками!
bulgarian: I'm creating my own destiny!

english: I also believe in fate.
french: Moi aussi, je crois au destin.
russian: Я тоже верю в судьбу.
bulgarian: I also believe in fate.

english: But I believe we have a hand in creating our destinies, too.
french: Mais je pense aussi que nous le façonnons, dans une certaine mesure.
russian: Но ещё я верю, что мы можем влиять на своё будущее.
bulgarian: But I believe we have a hand in creating our destinies, too.

english: Our lives, relationships, and fates...
french: Nos vies, nos relations et nos parcours...
russian: Наши жизни, отношения, судьбы...
bulgarian: Our lives, relationships, and fates...

english: They all form us as we're forming them.
french: Ils font de nous ce que nous sommes, mais c'est aussi nous qui les choisissons.
russian: Всё это нас формирует, но и мы формируем их.
bulgarian: They all form us as we're forming them.

english: Just think of all the paths that we took... that lead us both here.
french: Pense aux chemins que nous avons empruntés... et qui nous ont menés tous les deux ici.
russian: Только подумай, сколько развилок было на наших путях... прежде, чем мы оказались здесь вместе.
bulgarian: Just think of all the paths that we took... that lead us both here.

english: Surely, it's more than serendipity.
french: C'est bien plus qu'un simple hasard.
russian: Это не может быть просто счастливым совпадением.
bulgarian: Surely, it's more than serendipity.

english: I also believe that we form our own destinies.
french: Je crois que nous façonnons notre destin.
russian: Я тоже считаю, что мы создаём своё будущее.
bulgarian: I also believe that we form our own destinies.

english: In my studies, I've come to understand that our forebears put a great deal of stock into divine decree... destiny, if you will.
french: Au cours de mes travaux, j'ai compris que nos aïeux s'en remettaient souvent aux dieux... au destin, en quelque sorte.
russian: Занимаясь исследованиями, я выяснил, что наши предки глубоко верили в небесные законы... в судьбу, если угодно.
bulgarian: In my studies, I've come to understand that our forebears put a great deal of stock into divine decree... destiny, if you will.

english: But I'm glad that I was born in this one, [Ari]. Being able to discuss these curiosities together...
french: Mais je suis heureux d'être né dans celle-ci, [Ari]. Je peux discuter de ces antiquités avec toi.
russian: Но я доволен, что родился именно сейчас, [Ari]. Ведь у меня есть возможность обсуждать эти мелочи с тобой...
bulgarian: But I'm glad that I was born in this one, [Ari]. Being able to discuss these curiosities together...

english: Whether at the dig site, walking in the Deep Woods, or over tea and cake...
french: Qu'il s'agisse de nous rendre au site de fouilles, de nos balades à Boissombre ou de nos goûters...
russian: Во время раскопок, на прогулке в Глубокой чаще или за чаем с тортом...
bulgarian: Whether at the dig site, walking in the Deep Woods, or over tea and cake...

english: It means everything to me.
french: Rien ne compte plus pour moi.
russian: Для меня это важнее всего.
bulgarian: It means everything to me.

english: Whenever I turn up a fascinating artifact, I always get lost imagining what it would be like to live in the time period it came from.
french: Quand je découvre un artéfact fascinant, je me perds à imaginer la vie à cette époque.
russian: Когда мне попадается какая-нибудь впечатляющая находка, я всегда начинаю воображать, каково было жить в её время.
bulgarian: Whenever I turn up a fascinating artifact, I always get lost imagining what it would be like to live in the time period it came from.

english: Frankly, it's not nearly as impressive as our own!
french: Honnêtement, elle n'est pas aussi impressionnante que la nôtre, loin de là !
russian: И, честно: у нас с тобой гораздо интереснее, чем у них!
bulgarian: Frankly, it's not nearly as impressive as our own!

english: I've been translating a document that's focused on two historical figures' famous romance.
french: Je traduis un document qui se concentre sur l'histoire d'amour célèbre de deux grandes figures historiques.
russian: Я занимаюсь переводом одного документа, повествующего о знаменитом романе двух исторических личностей.
bulgarian: I've been translating a document that's focused on two historical figures' famous romance.

english: So how is it that I find myself tongue-tied whenever you draw near?
french: Alors, pourquoi je suis muet quand tu es près de moi ?
russian: Почему же при твоём приближении я начинаю теряться в словах?
bulgarian: So how is it that I find myself tongue-tied whenever you draw near?

english: Among the competencies I've trained for as a noble, I never considered my speech to be lacking.
french: Issu d'une famille noble, j'ai eu droit à toutes sortes d'enseignements et savoir parler était l'un d'eux.
russian: Среди навыков, которые прививались мне дворянским воспитанием, я всегда находил красноречие вполне достойным.
bulgarian: Among the competencies I've trained for as a noble, I never considered my speech to be lacking.

english: Oh, [Ari]!
french: Oh, [Ari] !
russian: Ой, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]!

english: Adeline has inherited many responsibilities as the future baroness, while I've been given the grace to explore life at my own pace.
french: En qualité d'héritière du titre, Adeline a de nombreuses responsabilités, alors que je suis libre de vivre ma vie à mon rythme.
russian: Аделине как будущей баронессе досталась в наследство серьёзная ответственность. А мне дали возможность вести жизнь в своём темпе.
bulgarian: Adeline has inherited many responsibilities as the future baroness, while I've been given the grace to explore life at my own pace.

english: I hope that someday, if I have children of my own...
french: J'espère qu'un jour, si j'ai des enfants...
russian: Надеюсь, что когда-нибудь, если у меня будут дети...
bulgarian: I hope that someday, if I have children of my own...

english: They will enjoy the same freedom to pursue their dreams.
french: Eux aussi pourront jouir de cette liberté de réaliser leurs rêves.
russian: Они тоже смогут идти за мечтой без преград.
bulgarian: They will enjoy the same freedom to pursue their dreams.

english: Ha ha!
french: Ha ha !
russian: Ха-ха!
bulgarian: Ha ha!

english: Oh, [Ari]... thank you.
french: Oh, [Ari]... Merci.
russian: Ох, [Ari]... Спасибо.
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]... thank you.

english: I assure you though, I'm far too low in the line of succession to truly make the running for princehood!
french: Mais je t'assure que je suis trop loin dans l'ordre de succession pour espérer devenir prince un jour !
russian: Но я тебя уверяю, в порядке наследования я стою слишком низко, чтобы претендовать на титул принца!
bulgarian: I assure you though, I'm far too low in the line of succession to truly make the running for princehood!

english: Sorry, I was lost in thought.
french: Désolé, j'étais perdu dans mes pensées.
russian: Прости, я задумался.
bulgarian: Sorry, I was lost in thought.

english: What's on your mind?
french: À quoi pensais-tu ?
russian: О чём ты думаешь?
bulgarian: What's on your mind?

english: Is everything okay?
french: Tout va bien ?
russian: Что-то случилось?
bulgarian: Is everything okay?

english: Ah, well. It's just...
french: Eh bien, c'est que...
russian: А, это. Просто...
bulgarian: Ah, well. It's just...

english: I've been thinking more about the future recently.
french: Je réfléchis de plus en plus à l'avenir ces temps-ci.
russian: В последнее время я стал больше думать о будущем.
bulgarian: I've been thinking more about the future recently.

english: I've always known that Adeline would be my parents' heir.
french: J'ai toujours su qu'Adeline succéderait à mes parents.
russian: Я всегда знал, что наследницей дома станет Аделина.
bulgarian: I've always known that Adeline would be my parents' heir.

english: I've always been grateful for that.
french: D'ailleurs, je leur en ai toujours été reconnaissant.
russian: И я всегда был ей за это благодарен.
bulgarian: I've always been grateful for that.

english: But knowing that I have few prospects outside the ones I make for myself...
french: Mais je m'aperçois que c'est à moi seul de décider de mon avenir...
russian: Но в то же время это значит, что меня ждёт только то, чего я смогу достичь сам...
bulgarian: But knowing that I have few prospects outside the ones I make for myself...

english: How do you feel about that?
french: Qu'en penses-tu, toi ?
russian: Что ты думаешь на этот счёт?
bulgarian: How do you feel about that?

english: I'm happy that you've been able to pursue your passions freely!
french: C'est fantastique que tu puisses t'adonner à tes passions librement !
russian:
Я

рады

радарадрадо, что ты можешь спокойно заниматься своими любимыми делами.
bulgarian: I'm happy that you've been able to pursue your passions freely!

english: It doesn't matter. You're a prince to me, Eiland.
french: Peu m'importe. Pour moi, tu es un prince, Eiland.
russian: Это не важно. Для меня ты настоящий принц, Эйланд.
bulgarian: It doesn't matter. You're a prince to me, Eiland.

english: [Ari]... I'm so glad that you understand.
french: [Ari]... Je suis si content que tu me comprennes.
russian: [Ari]... Спасибо, что понимаешь меня.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I'm so glad that you understand.

english: It's a gift for you from Ladybird, the bakery run by Ryis' family!
french: Ce cadeau vient du Bec fin, la boulangerie des parents de Ryis !
russian: Это подарок для тебя из «Печушки» — столичной пекарни, которую держит семья Риза!
bulgarian: It's a gift for you from Ladybird, the bakery run by Ryis' family!

english: I thought you might enjoy trying their specialty, the =Golden Cheesecake=.
french: Je me suis dit que tu aimerais goûter leur spécialité, le =cheese-cake doré=.
russian: Я подумал, тебе понравится их фирменный =золотой чизкейк=.
bulgarian: I thought you might enjoy trying their specialty, the =Golden Cheesecake=.

english: Please, enjoy it while it's still fresh.
french: Allez, mange-le tant qu'il est encore frais.
russian: Пожалуйста, попробуй, пока он свежий.
bulgarian: Please, enjoy it while it's still fresh.

english: There you are, [Ari]! I just received a most urgent parcel from the Capital...
french: Te voilà, [Ari] ! Je viens de recevoir un colis urgent de la capitale...
russian: Вот ты где, [Ari]! Я только что получил крайне срочную посылку из столицы...
bulgarian: There you are, [Ari]! I just received a most urgent parcel from the Capital...

english: I was obliged to learn court etiquette growing up, so I learned to play from a young age.
french: Dès mon plus jeune âge, j'ai dû apprendre l'étiquette de la cour. J'ai donc commencé le piano très tôt.
russian: В детстве я был обязан изучать придворный этикет, поэтому я научился играть с ранних лет.
bulgarian: I was obliged to learn court etiquette growing up, so I learned to play from a young age.

english: I'm afraid I haven't been keeping up my practice as much as I should...
french: Malheureusement, je n'ai pas pratiqué autant qu'il le faudrait...
russian: К сожалению, я практикуюсь реже, чем следует...
bulgarian: I'm afraid I haven't been keeping up my practice as much as I should...

english: But if you'd like a recital, I wouldn't mind looking a little foolish for you.
french: Si tu veux que je te joue un récital, j'aurai l'air un peu ridicule, mais ce n'est pas grave si c'est pour toi.
russian: Но если хочешь, могу устроить тебе сольный концерт. Перед тобой мне не страшно слегка оплошать.
bulgarian: But if you'd like a recital, I wouldn't mind looking a little foolish for you.

english: Have I ever played the piano for you, [Ari]?
french: Dis-moi. Je t'ai déjà joué du piano, [Ari] ?
russian: Я когда-нибудь играл тебе на фортепиано, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Have I ever played the piano for you, [Ari]?

english: But you look stunningly windswept today, [Ari].
french: Mais tu as une mine incroyable aujourd'hui, [Ari].
russian: Но сейчас ты сногсшибательно выглядишь, [Ari], когда ветер колышет твои волосы.
bulgarian: But you look stunningly windswept today, [Ari].

english: It might be all the Mistrian sunshine and ocean air...
french: C'est peut-être le beau temps et l'air marin de Mistria...
russian: Может быть, дело в мистрийском солнце или в морском воздухе...
bulgarian: It might be all the Mistrian sunshine and ocean air...

english: Balor clued me in on a new chocolatier in the Capital, so I ordered a box of their highly coveted first batch...
french: Balor m'avait parlé d'un nouveau chocolatier à la capitale, alors j'ai commandé une boîte de leur plus bel assortiment...
russian: Балор подсказал мне одного нового шоколатье в столице, и я заказал коробку из их долгожданной первой партии.
bulgarian: Balor clued me in on a new chocolatier in the Capital, so I ordered a box of their highly coveted first batch...

english: I'd like to share them with you.
french: J'aimerais qu'on les déguste ensemble.
russian: Я хочу разделить её с тобой.
bulgarian: I'd like to share them with you.

english: [Ari]! I got you something.
french: [Ari] ! J'ai quelque chose pour toi.
russian: [Ari]! У меня для тебя кое-что есть.
bulgarian: [Ari]! I got you something.

english: Would you like to take a break with me? Have a little snack?
french: Que dirais-tu de faire une pause avec moi ? Nous pourrions manger un petit quelque chose ?
russian: Хочешь, немного отдохнём вместе? Устроим небольшой перекус?
bulgarian: Would you like to take a break with me? Have a little snack?

english: These were freshly made this morning. Take this one, it looks the biggest!
french: Tout est de ce matin. Prends celui-ci, je crois que c'est le plus gros !
russian: Только сегодня утром испекли. Возьми вот этот, он побольше!
bulgarian: These were freshly made this morning. Take this one, it looks the biggest!

english: [Ari]! I couldn't imagine better timing!
french: [Ari] ! Tu tombes bien !
russian: [Ari]! Ты как раз в подходящий момент!
bulgarian: [Ari]! I couldn't imagine better timing!

english: I wonder how that feels for the $Night Queen$, to expend all its energy for one grand moment, only to go dormant?
french: Je me demande ce que ça lui fait de mettre toute son énergie pour ce seul événement, avant de retourner en sommeil.
russian: Заставляет задуматься: каково ей отдать все свои силы ради одного звёздного часа, а затем уйти в спячку?
bulgarian: I wonder how that feels for the $Night Queen$, to expend all its energy for one grand moment, only to go dormant?

english: That's what I like about conserving history. It allows us to look back and appreciate life's fleeting nature.
french: C'est pour ça que j'aime préserver tout ce qui est historique. Ainsi, nous pouvons observer le passé et apprécier la fugacité de la vie.
russian: Поэтому мне нравится сохранять историческую память. Это позволяет оглянуться назад и насладиться проходящей мимолётностью жизни.
bulgarian: That's what I like about conserving history. It allows us to look back and appreciate life's fleeting nature.

english: Like... this moment here with you. I hope you'll remember it, too.
french: Comme ce moment passé ensemble. J'espère que tu t'en souviendras, toi aussi.
russian: Как, например... наша с тобой сегодняшняя встреча. Надеюсь, ты её тоже запомнишь.
bulgarian: Like... this moment here with you. I hope you'll remember it, too.

english: It's said that a $Night Queen$ only flowers once, for a single night each year.
french: Il paraît que la $fleur de lune$ ne fleurit qu'une fois par an, le temps d'une nuit.
russian: Говорят, $царица ночи$ цветёт лишь одну ночь в году.
bulgarian: It's said that a $Night Queen$ only flowers once, for a single night each year.
